summary.overview: Design review of current test fixtures. Clamp plate shift traced to a single dowel; team agreed on round plus diamond pin. Knee fixture side load at end of flexion travel blamed on rod end slop, moving to a spherical bearing at the top clevis. Hip load frame gusset change still unreleased pending FEA rerun. Open list read out, one date moved.
shorthand_bullet: clamp plate walks on torque-down, slotted holes, only one dowel
fix: round pin + diamond pin, ream in-house, Carlos wants a marked-up drawing
knee fixture: off-axis load at end of sweep, rod end slop
swap to spherical bearing at top clevis (load cell side), needs bore + ring groove
hip load frame gusset change in model, not released, FEA rerun w/ heavier load case, refine fillet mesh
Battery enclosure thermal runaway containment now 11/4
two torque wrenches past cal, pulled
